notes.title: Chinese language patch is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After working hard on localization and testing, the Chinese patch of Neon City Raiders has officially released today!

I hope this update of the Chinese version allows you to experience and understand the world of our game more conveniently!

notes.title: Neon City Riders: Super-Powered Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36291868/e507201a8b9d8e682b4859393cedc7ba298dee08.png[/img]

We can't thank you enough for all your support during launch. We are so glad that the project we pour our hearts and love into during three long years is so well received.

Also, we love to get involved with the community and listen to your feedback. Our priority is that Neon City Riders become the best experience it can be.

And, that's why we have been working hard to add tons of new features to the original experience. Here are the most important ones:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36291868/653ef225bbce6392ad54fbdc173db49bd0b41089.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36291868/5729aaf013ae623bdf0664186d64753fa42e3773.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36291868/529ee1abbfa99576a85ed42bc757fed0d2665cfa.png[/img]

We know that Neon City Riders' difficulty is one of its main features, but it's also very important for us to make it approachable to as many gamers as possible.

[b]By default, Neon City Riders' enemies, hazards, puzzles, checkpoint locations and map designs were re-balanced to be more accesible. [/b]

And, if you are a fan of challenges, like we do, the new option "Old-School mode" is available to increase the overall difficulty of your quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36291868/1969ae4ec34b5762a105fcd4c5f46378ebe0cd90.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36291868/7061c128d3c79e5a00aaaf5b6caa8b54a20a28f3.png[/img]

We introduce [b]Cypher Kid[/b], a chatty little robot who will gladly (and optionally) sell you maps for the different turfs to help you navigate its sections.

Also, your mentor, [b]Evergray[/b], will help you at the begging of each zone by pointing you at the right direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36291868/5729aaf013ae623bdf0664186d64753fa42e3773.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36291868/2c68bab513a350f13cf298fdfbc5d4f04543c874.png[/img]

Thinking on the players with light sensitivity, we decided to add a new option that turns on/off the fast paced colors in the user's interface across the game to make their journey as comfy as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36291868/1969ae4ec34b5762a105fcd4c5f46378ebe0cd90.png[/img]
[h3]This update is now available for free on steam![/h3]

Thank you very much for your support and feedback. We are sure this improvements will enhance your gameplay, and we hope newcomers and returning players enjoy of this new experience. All your feedback is welcome!

Regards and stay safe!
